title: Rivergate and Monsoon
author: Gideon Vane
blurb: Elodie Galloway, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
